Every other bare Any in src/ and scripts/ at e004a97 sits directly under adapters/. The new file has no PLC0415 trigger (no function-local imports) and no PLR0913 trigger (at most two parameters). The author reports lint passed on e004a97, which is consistent with coverage. A targeted ruff run, or a narrower return type, would settle it without touching pyproject.toml.
